The 'three-line model' in the context of AI service provider organizations refers to a governance framework proposed by the Institute of Internal Auditors. It includes three lines of defense for proper governance and organizational risk management: 

1. The first line consists of the department that develops and operates the AI system and service.
2. The second line is the risk management department that checks and balances the development and operation of the AI services and systems.
3. The third line is the internal audit department that independently verifies and audits the management and executive departments. 

This model aims to enhance and improve governance and management within organizations providing AI services and systems.
